mapper.select: select counters.post_id as post_id, counters.view_count as view_count, counters.like_count as like_count, counters.comment_count as comment_count, counters.bookmark_count as bookmark_count, coalesce(score.score, 0) as score, greatest(counters.flush_revision, coalesce(score.flush_revision, 0)) as revision from post_counter_snapshot counters left join post_score_snapshot score on score.post_id = counters.post_id where counters.post_id = #{postId, jdbcType=BINARY}
mapper.insert: insert into post_counter_snapshot( post_id, view_count, like_count, comment_count, bookmark_count, flush_revision ) values( #{postId, jdbcType=BINARY}, #{viewCount}, #{likeCount}, #{commentCount}, #{bookmarkCount}, #{revision} ) on duplicate key update view_count = case when values(flush_revision) > flush_revision then values(view_count) else view_count end, like_count = case when values(flush_revision) > flush_revision then values(like_count) else like_count end, comment_count = case when values(flush_revision) > flush_revision then values(comment_count) else comment_count end, bookmark_count = case when values(flush_revision) > flush_revision then values(bookmark_count) else bookmark_count end, flush_revision = greatest(flush_revision, values(flush_revision))

insert into post_score_snapshot( post_id, score, rank_version, flush_revision ) values( #{postId, jdbcType=BINARY}, #{score}, #{rankVersion}, #{revision} ) on duplicate key update score = case when values(flush_revision) > flush_revision then values(score) else score end, rank_version = case when values(flush_revision) > flush_revision then values(rank_version) else rank_version end, flush_revision = greatest(flush_revision, values(flush_revision))
